title: Existence of normalized torsor section evaluation
statement: Let $V$ be a nonempty connected scheme, $\ell$ prime, $P$ a finite group, and $c:Y\to V$ a finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor with nonempty connected total space. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbb F_\ell)$-modules and $A$ such a module, with $c^*F\cong\underline A_Y$ [def-weil-connected-scheme, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For the explicitly constructed representation $N_F$ and presheaf $Q_F$ [def-weil-pbc-torsor-section-representation], there exists a natural module morphism $\alpha:F\to Q_F$ satisfying $\alpha_Y(s)(\Delta(y))=s$ for all sections $s\in F(Y)$ and points $y\in Y$. Bijectivity of $\alpha$ is not part of this statement.

source.place: Tags 0DV5 (3), 0DV6 and 0A3R, proof identifying the restricted representation; sites.tex Tags 04TR and 04TS (gluing sheaves and mapping property), with module operations as in 0DV5 (3); explicit section-evaluation implementation of the fixed-torsor argument

proof.text: Identify the inverse image along the etale cover with restriction to the small etale site of Y. The constant trivialization identifies this restriction with locally constant functions valued in A. Since Y is nonempty connected, its global locally constant functions are constant, so A is canonically identified with F(Y) by restriction of global sections.

Restrict s in F(W) to W times_V Y and read it as a locally constant function with values in F(Y). Changing the second factor by g changes its value by F(g inverse): if x represents its value before the change, restriction of x along g inverse represents its value afterwards. Thus it is equivariant for the explicit inverse-deck-action representation. Linearity follows from restriction and scalar transport, and naturality follows from restriction on fibre products.
For W=Y, restriction of s along the diagonal is s. Therefore evaluating the constructed function on the diagonal gives s at every point y, which is exactly the normalization in the conclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.GaloisCover.exists_sectionEvaluation
    {V : Scheme.{u}} [ConnectedSpace V] (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (P : Type u) [Group P] [Finite P]
    (c : Scheme.GaloisCover (ULift.{u + 1} P) V) [ConnectedSpace c.P]
    (F : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))))
    (A : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))
    (h : Nonempty ((c.π)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ))].obj F ≅
      (constantSheaf c.P.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod ℓ)))).obj A)) :
    ∃ α : F.obj ⟶ c.sectionRepresentationPresheaf ℓ F,
      c.SectionEvaluationNormalized ℓ F α
